title: The ChumSMP
description: 🦦 The chum community is an safe space for everyone <3 there is no whitelist, Just hop in!
body:
## The ChumSMP
We are a community centric server focused on being a welcoming space for everyone, we have a strong eye on fair play, events and having fun.

we are **strongly against** pay to win, we do not have a traditional ranked system we are purely donation funded!

![A sniffer in the sunset](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/224f6606225a10f689e967628f490d37c3191f6a.jpeg)
### What makes us special?

We are able to create our own plugins, this means unique events where the sky is the limit, things never seen before on a small community of people who become close friends.
we are only getting better and better every day, **you wont want to miss this.**
